questions.stem: They said they ____ (buy) a new house.

options.distractor: 主句是过去时，are 要变 were
主句过去时，will 要变 would

questions.explanation: 主句 said 是过去时，打算用 were going to buy。

questions.stem: I ____ (visit) my friend yesterday, but I was too busy.

options.distractor: visited 表示去成了，与 but 后面的意思矛盾

questions.explanation: but 说明没去成，是“本来打算去”，用 was going to visit。

questions.stem: He ____ (take) the bus, but he missed it.

options.distractor: took 表示坐上了车，与 missed 矛盾

questions.explanation: but he missed it 说明没坐上车，是“本来打算坐”，用 was going to take。

questions.stem: We ____ (watch) the game together, but the TV didn't work.

options.distractor: watched 表示看成了，与电视坏了矛盾

questions.explanation: 电视坏了说明没看成，是“本来打算一起看”，用 were going to watch。

options.text: He said he was going to come to the party.
We were going to leave when it started to rain.
She said she is going to be late.
I was going to call you, but I forgot.

questions.explanation: 主句 said 是过去时，应改为 She said she was going to be late。

questions.stem: — Why didn't you come to the party? — I ____ (come), but my bike was broken.

options.distractor: came 表示来了，与问句矛盾

questions.explanation: 没去成派对，是“本来打算来”，用 was going to come。
